symptom: Forms$TemplateGridContents.Widgets was written with marker 3 when its first child had no child-type registration (e.g. a TabControl), when emptied, and on selective rebuild, and was omitted when new and empty; Studio Pro writes [2]
cause: TemplateGridContents was left off the Widgets property-marker owner list because neither reference app has a template grid
insight: No reference document is not no evidence: mx convert (11.15.0) re-serializes every unit, so injecting a deliberately wrong marker ([3]) and reading the converted BSON measures Studio Pro's serializer directly - with a control (a DivContainer written [3] comes back [2]) proving the unit was rewritten. A bare injected element is also filled out by convert, which shows mandatory keys. The same probe settles which gen types are dead: convert refuses Forms$TableCell, Forms$VerticalFlow and NativePages$NativeLayoutCallArgument/NativePage ('type cache does not contain a type'), and an 11.x table cell is Forms$DbTableCell, which gen does not model (decoded opaque), so registering any of them would be inert.
